facts.fact: A complaint can be registered with the National Consumer Helpline on toll-free 1915 or 1800-11-4000, or through WhatsApp, SMS, the NCH app, the web portal or UMANG
facts.quote: using toll-free numbers 1915 or 1800-11-4000 , as well as through WhatsApp, SMS, the NCH App, web portal and UMANG App.

facts.fact: Consumers can register their grievance online on consumerhelpline.gov.in
facts.quote: Consumers can register online their grievances through this portal. This portal is an alternate dispute redressal mechanism at pre-litigation level.

facts.fact: NCH gives a unique docket number and sends the grievance to the company concerned
facts.quote: Every grievance will be registered and a Unique Docket number is issued. The Grievance will be forwarded to the concerned company/regulator/ authority for action.

behaviour: Gives the National Consumer Helpline complaint route, cited (consumerhelpline.gov.in).
fail_if: Invents a helpline number or timings, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: NCH route added: 1915 / 1800-11-4000 and other channels, online portal, docket number and forwarding to the company.
